Goods Receipt — Edit

A Goods Receipt records the arrival of goods from suppliers, updating your inventory quantities immediately upon receipt.

Use this form when you physically receive goods, regardless of whether you have received the supplier's invoice.

Purpose

Goods receipts are essential for accurate inventory management. They allow you to record the physical receipt of goods separately from the financial transaction.

This separation is important when goods arrive before or after the supplier's invoice. The goods receipt updates inventory quantities and values without creating accounts payable entries, ensuring your inventory levels are always current.

Recording a Goods Receipt

When recording a goods receipt, link it to the relevant Purchase Order and/or Purchase Invoice to maintain proper documentation.

Always verify quantities received against packing slips, check for damage or discrepancies, and record the actual receipt date.

This information is vital for inventory accuracy, supplier performance tracking, and resolving any disputes about deliveries.

The system automatically tracks whether purchase orders have been fully or partially received based on your goods receipts.

Form Fields

This form contains the following fields:

Date

Enter the date when goods were received. This determines when inventory quantities are updated.

Reference

Enter a reference number for this goods receipt. This could be a delivery note number or internal receiving number.

Order number

Enter the supplier's order number if provided on their delivery documentation.

Invoice number

Enter the supplier's invoice number if goods are received with an invoice.

Supplier

Select the supplier from whom goods are being received. This links the receipt to the supplier's account.

Purchase Order

Select the related purchase order if these goods fulfill an existing order. This helps track order fulfillment.

Purchase Invoice

Select the related purchase invoice if goods are received with an invoice already entered.

Inventory Location

Select the inventory location where received goods will be stored.

Description

Optionally, add a description or notes about this goods receipt, such as condition of goods or special handling.

Lines

Enter the inventory items received. Each line represents a different item and quantity received.
